sources.title: Recap: Miami beats Duke 36-25
sources.description: The Miami Hurricanes started off their home stretch of ACC games on the right foot, defeating former Canes head coach Manny Diaz and his Duke Blue Devils 36-25 on Saturday afternoon at Hard Rock Stadium.
